onboarding.welcome.title: Wunder Tutor
onboarding.welcome.sub: Speak with confidence — one sound at a time.
onboarding.welcome.promise.see: See exactly which sound — or tone — to fix
onboarding.welcome.fineprint: For ages 5 to grown-up. Setup takes about a minute.
onboarding.languages.title: Which languages?
onboarding.languages.sub: The home language shows which sounds and tones will be trickiest.
onboarding.languages.hint: Pick one or both — you can switch between them any time.
onboarding.who.name.adult.label: Name
onboarding.who.name.child.label: Nickname
onboarding.who.band.little: Picture-led lessons with single words and tiny phrases.
onboarding.who.band.teen: A cleaner look with full, natural sentences.
onboarding.who.adultHint: The grown-up version: a clean look, natural sentences, and the phonetic detail when you want it.
onboarding.who.title: Who’s learning?
onboarding.who.sub: Age sets the look, the words and how much reading there is.
onboarding.level.label: Level
onboarding.level.new.title: Just starting
onboarding.level.new.detail: Knows a few words or none yet
onboarding.level.some.title: Knows some already
onboarding.level.confident.title: Quite confident
onboarding.level.confident.detail: Wants to sound clearer and more natural
onboarding.level.goal.label: Learning for
onboarding.accent.title: Which English accent?
onboarding.accent.us.title: American English
onboarding.accent.us.detail: water sounds like “wah-der” · the most detailed feedback
onboarding.accent.uk.title: British English
onboarding.accent.hint: Both are correct English. Your choice sets the teacher’s voice, and the other accent’s sounds are never marked as mistakes.
onboarding.script.title: Which Chinese characters?
onboarding.script.hant.title: 繁體 Traditional
onboarding.script.hant.detail: 蘋果 · as in Hong Kong schools
onboarding.script.hans.title: 简体 Simplified
onboarding.script.hans.detail: 苹果 · as in mainland textbooks
onboarding.script.hint: Pinyin with tone marks is shown above every character either way.
onboarding.consent.title: Voice & privacy
onboarding.consent.sub.adult: Here’s exactly what happens to your recordings.
onboarding.consent.sub.child: A child’s voice is sensitive. Here’s exactly what happens to it.
onboarding.consent.mic.title: The microphone is only on while the mic button is red.
onboarding.consent.mic.body.adult: You tap to start and it stops by itself.
onboarding.consent.mic.body.named: {name} taps to start and it stops by itself.
onboarding.consent.mic.body.unnamed: Your child taps to start and it stops by itself.
onboarding.consent.recordings.title: Recordings are kept on this device.
onboarding.consent.recordings.body.adult: They let you hear “before” and “now”. Scores are stored separately from voice.
onboarding.consent.recordings.body.named: They let {name} hear “before” and “now”. Scores are stored separately from voice.
onboarding.consent.recordings.body.unnam: They let your child hear “before” and “now”. Scores are stored separately from voice.
onboarding.consent.control.title: You’re in control.
onboarding.consent.control.body.adult: Delete recordings, history or the whole profile any time in {settings} (on the {tab} tab).
onboarding.consent.control.body.child: Delete recordings, history or the whole profile any time in {settings}.
onboarding.consent.contribute.adult: Help improve Wunder Tutor: let the team keep my practice recordings, with no name
onboarding.consent.contribute.child: Help improve Wunder Tutor: let the team keep these practice recordings, with no name
onboarding.consent.agree.child: I’m the parent or guardian and I agree to microphone use
onboarding.consent.micBlocked: Microphone not allowed yet — you can fix this in a moment
onboarding.handover.sub: Pass the device over. Pip will listen to a few words to see which sounds need help — there are no wrong answers.
onboarding.plan.focus.zh: Tones and sounds to work on
onboarding.plan.hint.adult: These will come up in your lessons until they’re easy.
onboarding.plan.hint.child: Pip will bring these into lessons and remember how they go — they’ll keep coming back until they’re easy.
onboarding.plan.sub.child: Based on what Pip just heard.
onboarding.check.hint: These come back in lessons and the Lab until they’re easy.
